voiceSummary: Salzer Electronics Limited has made the audio recording of the earnings call for the financial results of the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, available on its website. The company filed this notice with BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. on November 13, 2026. The audio file is accessible via the link https://www.salzergroup.net/audio/WhatsApp Audio 2026-11-13 at 1.13.45 PM.mp3. This disclosure was submitted in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. K M Murugesan, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication on behalf of the company.

attchmntText: Salzer Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Salzer Electronics Limited submitted an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated net profit of Rs. 56,138.60 thousand for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to Rs. 57,497.39 thousand in the corresponding period of the previous year. The presentation included details on shareholding patterns, with promoters holding 94,000 shares and public holding 51,000 shares. It also outlined the company's strategy to expand its product portfolio and enhance operational efficiency. The document further mentioned the appointment of statutory auditors and other compliance-related updates for the financial year 2026-27.

attchmntText: Salzer Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Salzer Electronics Limited reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 579.77 crore for Q2 FY27, a 38.40% year-on-year increase. Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs. 39.95 crore with a margin of 6.89%. Profit after tax was Rs. 14.87 crore. For the first half of FY27, consolidated revenue reached Rs. 1,077.79 crore, up 25.32% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 71.26 crore. Mr. Raman Krishnamoorthy was appointed CFO effective April 1, 2026. The company targets EBITDA margins of approximately 10% by FY27. Operations at the Saudi Arabia facility are now expected to commence in April 2027 due to regional uncertainties. The Government of India approved the Rs. 1.86 lakh crore PM-DHARA scheme on 30th September 2026.

voiceSummary: Salzer Electronics Limited filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations regarding its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated net revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 579.77 crore, showing 38.40% year-on-year growth. Half-year net revenue stood at Rs. 1,077.79 crore, a 25.32% increase. Q2 EBITDA excluding other income was Rs. 39.95 crore with a margin of 6.89%. Profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 14.87 crore. The company noted elevated raw material costs impacting margins. Operations at the Saudi Arabia facility are delayed due to regional conflict, with commencement expected from April 2027.

attchmntText: Salzer Electronics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Salzer Electronics Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during its Board meeting on November 12, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 105224.51 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 2196.58 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 12.42. The company made an additional investment of Rs. 41.53 lakh in Effilume Private Limited, increasing its stake to 49%. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were Rs. 145364.99 lakhs. Statutory auditors Swamy & Ravi issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were identified.
